description:
Return one R3 document in full, or one API symbol. Paths come from r3_docs_list:
  r3_docs_read("CODE_PATTERNS.md")          how a Code component is written — read this first
  r3_docs_read("PHYSICS_USAGE.md")          colliders, rigid bodies, joints
  r3_docs_read("HOWTO_PHYSICS.md")          one task step by step (how-tos: r3_docs_list)
  r3_docs_read("api")                       index of every component, system and event
  r3_docs_read("api/component/Mesh")        one component
  r3_docs_read("api/system/PhysicsRapier")  one system
  r3_docs_read("api/event/KEY_DOWN")        one event, and the data it delivers
The API reference is only ever read one symbol at a time — the whole file is ~246KB.
name: r3_docs_read
title: Read one R3 document
